blocks.text: In 2002, Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the platform category, Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
